notes: Posted 19 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting Stuff (10): Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Epic Duel, Start Your Engines!, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Watto's Box; these count toward the 60. The draft had dropped Start Your Engines (posted with a comment that it is not listed again in interrupts).

Posted 'TFHGOOFTU' dested the objective's back side; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'DVDLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Mata Jade' (typo) Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (the deck runs Mara Jade's Lightsaber and the strategy says 'three Maras'); 'Dr. E/Ponda Combo' Dr. Evazan & •Ponda Baba; '4-LOM with Gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Sebulba's Racer' Sebulba's Podracer; 'POTF' Presence Of The Force; 'Monnock' Monnok; 'Visage of the Emporer' Visage Of The Emperor.
Podrace Arena and Boonta Eve Podrace dested the Dark pages. No Escape is the Jabba's Palace Effect (the Reflections III shield came later).
Total is 61 as published: Effects is headed (5) but lists No Escape, POTF x3 and Visage x2 (6). The strategy says 'there should only be two POTF', which would make 60; the published count is kept.
The strategy says the deck went 8-0 in unnamed local tournaments; no event is named, so it stays a general deck.
